# Smart Tool

**Author:** Siemens AG<br/>
**Platforms:** ODM

<div className="screenshot">

![Smart Tool: screenshot 1](./smart-tool/img/smart-tool.png)

</div>

Official Siemens software for working with ST55 and ST60 phones via a serial port. Smart Tool allows you to:

- Read, edit, and write the phonebook;
- Read, archive, create, and send SMS;
- Copy photos, logos, wallpaper images, melodies, audio, and video files;
- Create melodies in the built-in editor.

Phonebook and message encoding selection is supported, including Cyrillic.
